ghosts.name: Pontianak
ghosts.origin: Woman who died in childbirth (Malay cognate of Kuntilanak).
ghosts.behavior: Banana-tree and riverside haunting; long nails; scent of frangipani then foul odor.
ghosts.deterrents: Nail driven into the neck hole (classic Malay lore); prayers.

ghosts.name: Kuntilanak Merah
ghosts.origin: Violent or unjust death variant of Kuntilanak, marked by the red dress.
ghosts.behavior: More aggressive haunting; appears at roads and abandoned houses.
ghosts.deterrents: Prayers; iron / protective amulets in popular retellings.

ghosts.name: Nyai Blorong
ghosts.morphology: Serpent / naga hybrid (woman above, snake below)
ghosts.origin: Wealth-granting serpent queen in pesugihan lore, servant of Nyi Roro Kidul in some tellings.
ghosts.behavior: Grants riches in exchange for a life-price over time.
ghosts.deterrents: Breaking the pact is said to be fatal; ritual counsel sought.

ghosts.name: Dewi Lanjar
ghosts.origin: Guardian queen of the north coast and its jin realms in Pekalongan lore.
ghosts.behavior: Rules coastal spirits; grants or withholds favor to fishers and traders.
ghosts.deterrents: Offerings and respect for coastal taboos.

ghosts.name: Nyi Pelet
ghosts.origin: Embodiment of pelet love-magic; a beautiful woman whose charm compels obsession.
ghosts.behavior: Causes unnatural infatuation and ruin of households.
ghosts.deterrents: Counter-magic and prayers by a dukun.

ghosts.name: Calon Arang
ghosts.origin: Widow of Girah (12th-c. legend) whose black magic brought plague when her daughter was shunned.
ghosts.behavior: Sends teluh pestilence; dances with corpses in graveyards.
ghosts.deterrents: Defeated, in legend, by Mpu Bharadah's disciple stealing her magic book.

ghosts.name: Kolor Ijo
ghosts.origin: Modern urban-legend predator demon in green underwear, reported in 2000s Java.
ghosts.behavior: Attacks women at night; climbs into houses.
ghosts.deterrents: Community patrols and prayers in popular accounts.

ghosts.name: Pastur Kepala Buntung
ghosts.origin: Headless Dutch-era priest said to haunt Jeruk Purut cemetery.
ghosts.behavior: Wanders the cemetery at night carrying his head / seeking his grave.

ghosts.name: Hantu Jeruk Purut
ghosts.origin: Cemetery haunting cluster at TPU Jeruk Purut, Jakarta.
ghosts.behavior: Night-time apparitions near old graves and banyan trees.

ghosts.name: Kereta Hantu Manggarai
ghosts.origin: Ghost train said to run the Manggarai–Bogor line, linked to the 1987 Bintaro crash in popular memory.
ghosts.behavior: Appears as a driverless train on the tracks at night.

ghosts.name: Hantu Ambulans Bandung
ghosts.origin: Ambulance from a Dutch-era house on Jl. Bahureksa, Bandung, said to move and sound its siren by itself.
ghosts.behavior: Siren heard at night; vehicle found moved.
ghosts.deterrents: None specific; house is a local landmark tale.

ghosts.name: Mak Lampir
ghosts.origin: Witch-queen popularized nationally by the Misteri Gunung Merapi TV serial.
ghosts.behavior: Commands demons and seeks power / revenge from her mountain lair.
ghosts.deterrents: Heroic counter-magic in the serial's lore.

ghosts.name: Grandong
ghosts.origin: Wealth familiar kept for pesugihan; said to demand milk and blood offerings.
ghosts.behavior: Brings money to its keeper; sickens household members over time.
ghosts.deterrents: Destroying the keeping ritual / religious counsel.

ghosts.name: Pocong Merah
ghosts.origin: Aggressive red-shrouded pocong variant in contemporary urban legend.
ghosts.behavior: Hops and chases; associated with violent death.

ghosts.name: Orang Bunian
ghosts.origin: Hidden people living in forests and empty houses in Malay lore; weddings heard but unseen.
ghosts.behavior: Music and cooking smells from empty places; people who follow them may vanish in time.

ghosts.name: Hantu Galah
ghosts.origin: Tall pole-ghost of Malay lore whose legs span roads and rivers.
ghosts.behavior: Straddles paths; grows taller the more it is watched (cf. Begu Ganjang).

ghosts.name: Hantu Tinggi
ghosts.origin: Giant tall ghost of Malay forest lore.
ghosts.behavior: Seen towering over trees at forest edges.
ghosts.deterrents: Prayers; avoidance of forest at dusk.

ghosts.name: Hantu Kopek
ghosts.origin: Female apparition in roadside urban legend, named for its exposed form.
ghosts.behavior: Appears to lone male travelers at night, then vanishes.

ghosts.name: Hantu Rimba
ghosts.origin: Generic forest spirit / keeper of the rimba in Malay-Indonesian usage.
ghosts.behavior: Punishes disrespect to the forest; misleads intruders.
ghosts.deterrents: Permission rituals and offerings before entering forest.

ghosts.name: Mambang
ghosts.origin: Class of Malay elemental spirits (e.g., Mambang Kuning of the sunset).
ghosts.behavior: Inhabits natural phenomena; invoked in traditional healing.

ghosts.name: Putri Tangguk
ghosts.origin: Woman in Jambi legend who neglected her rice / children and was cursed.
ghosts.behavior: Appears near rice fields combing long hair; weeping.

ghosts.name: Mariaban
ghosts.origin: Giant red-haired forest being of Kalimantan river lore.
ghosts.behavior: Hunts along rivers; immensely strong.

ghosts.name: Hantu Banyu
ghosts.origin: Water ghost of Banjar rivers (banyu = water).
ghosts.behavior: Pulls swimmers and bathers under at dusk.
ghosts.deterrents: Prayers before bathing; avoid rivers at maghrib.

ghosts.name: Anak Sima
ghosts.origin: Child familiar kept for wealth / power in Kalimantan black-magic lore.
ghosts.behavior: Kept and fed by its keeper; brings luck at a price.
ghosts.deterrents: Religious counsel; destroying the keeping objects.

ghosts.name: Hantu Buaya Putih
ghosts.origin: White crocodile as transformed person / river guardian in widespread river lore.
ghosts.behavior: Appears as an albino crocodile that behaves like a human.
ghosts.deterrents: Offerings; do not harm a white crocodile.

ghosts.name: Memedi
ghosts.origin: Generic Javanese fright-spirit (memedi = that which frightens).
ghosts.behavior: Takes whatever form most frightens the witness.
ghosts.deterrents: Courage / prayers; form dissolves when faced calmly in tales.

ghosts.name: Tonya
ghosts.origin: Guardian spirit of a place (tonya) in South Sulawesi usage.
ghosts.behavior: Guards houses, trees and heirlooms; punishes theft.

ghosts.name: Naga Besukih
ghosts.origin: Cosmic naga of Balinese lore whose scales are said to become gold / wealth.
ghosts.behavior: Dwells in Mount Agung's realm; guards balance of the world.

ghosts.name: Parakang
ghosts.origin: South Sulawesi flying-head / organ-eater, cognate of Palasik and Kuyang.
ghosts.behavior: Transforms at night; attacks pregnant women and infants.
ghosts.deterrents: Garlic, sharp objects by the bed; expose the empty body.

ghosts.name: Pokpok
ghosts.origin: Witch form named for its 'pok-pok' sound in flight in South Sulawesi lore.
ghosts.behavior: Flies at night making pok-pok sounds; seeks pregnant victims.

ghosts.name: Longga
ghosts.origin: Tall stretching ghost of Sulawesi lore, cognate of Hantu Galah / Begu Ganjang.
ghosts.behavior: Grows taller when watched; haunts paths.

ghosts.name: Waruga spirit
ghosts.origin: Ancestral presence tied to waruga stone burial sarcophagi of Minahasa.
ghosts.behavior: Guards ancestral burial grounds.
ghosts.deterrents: Respect and offerings at waruga sites.

ghosts.name: Jin Qarin
ghosts.origin: Companion jin (qarin) said in Islamic tradition to accompany every person from birth.
ghosts.behavior: Whispers temptation; mimics its human after death in popular lore.

ghosts.name: Preta
ghosts.morphology: Gaunt hungry ghost (small mouth, huge belly)
ghosts.origin: Hungry ghost of Hindu-Buddhist cosmology, retained in Javanese / Balinese heritage.
ghosts.behavior: Wanders unable to eat or drink; fed by merit-transfer offerings.
ghosts.deterrents: Offerings and prayers for the dead.

ghosts.name: Hantu Air
ghosts.origin: Generic water ghost (hantu air) of rivers, lakes and wells across the Malay-Indonesian world.
ghosts.behavior: Drowns the careless; rises at dusk and in floods.
ghosts.deterrents: Prayers; pawang mediation; avoid water at dusk.

ghosts.name: Aswang
ghosts.origin: Umbrella Filipino viscera-sucker; long proboscis tongue in many tellings.
ghosts.behavior: Shapeshifts by day, hunts by night; tiktik sound grows fainter as it nears.

ghosts.name: Tikbalang
ghosts.origin: Horse-headed trickster of Philippine forests.
ghosts.behavior: Misleads travelers; causes disorientation.
ghosts.deterrents: Wear shirt inside-out; ask permission to pass.

ghosts.name: Phi Tai Hong
ghosts.origin: Ghost of a person who died violently / suddenly in Thai belief.
ghosts.behavior: Among the most feared and powerful phi; haunts the death site.

ghosts.name: Churel
ghosts.origin: Woman who died in childbirth / by injustice in South Asian lore; cognate motif to Kuntilanak.
ghosts.behavior: Seduces and drains young men; haunts burial and liminal places.
ghosts.deterrents: Iron, burial with thorns / rites in folk accounts.

ghosts.name: Aul
ghosts.origin: Headless being of Kalimantan forest lore, said to carry its head.
ghosts.behavior: Roams forest paths at night.

ghosts.name: Lelembut
ghosts.origin: Class of subtle Javanese spirits, often invisible, associated with refined places.
ghosts.behavior: Possesses or influences people quietly in kejawen lore.

ghosts.name: Siluman
ghosts.origin: Generic term for a transformed being / were-creature across Indonesian lore.
ghosts.behavior: Lives hidden among humans in animal or human form.

ghosts.name: Dedemit
ghosts.origin: Guardian spirit of wild / empty places (alas) in Javanese lore.
ghosts.behavior: Demands respect and offerings from those who clear land.

ghosts.name: Hantu Penunggu
ghosts.morphology: Guardian spirit of a place / building
ghosts.origin: Generic 'waiting / guarding' ghost (penunggu) of houses, trees, bridges and sites.
ghosts.behavior: Makes its presence felt when its place is disturbed.

ghosts.name: Matianak
ghosts.origin: Kalimantan name / cognate for the childbirth-death ghost (mati anak = died in childbirth).
ghosts.behavior: Haunts trees and riversides; attacks pregnant women and men.
ghosts.deterrents: Prayers; protective iron in folk lore.

ghosts.name: Pocong Gundul
ghosts.origin: Bald-headed pocong variant popularized by contemporary Indonesian horror film.
ghosts.behavior: Hops and pursues victims from a haunted school / site in film lore.

ghosts.name: Hantu Pusako
ghosts.origin: Guardian tied to Minangkabau ancestral heirloom property and houses (rumah gadang).
ghosts.behavior: Punishes those who wrongfully sell or divide pusako land.

ghosts.name: Kambe
ghosts.origin: Wild man / hairy humanoid of West Sulawesi highland lore.
ghosts.behavior: Shy, avoids villages; raids gardens in some accounts.
ghosts.deterrents: None specific — biological entity in witness accounts.

ghosts.name: Orang Gigi
ghosts.origin: Forest humanoid in Sumatran local lore, grouped here as a regional cryptid report.
ghosts.behavior: Avoids humans; leaves tracks near rivers.
